name: Equation of Continuity
description: States that for an incompressible fluid, the volume flow rate remains constant throughout a pipe.

name: Bernoulli's Equation
formula: p + 1/2 ρ v^2 + ρ g h = constant
description: Represents the conservation of energy for a flowing fluid, relating pressure, kinetic energy, and potential energy.

name: Newton's Law of Viscosity
description: Defines the coefficient of viscosity as the ratio of shear stress to the velocity gradient.

name: Stokes' Law
description: Expresses the drag force acting on a spherical object moving through a viscous fluid.

name: Surface Tension
description: Defines surface tension as the force acting parallel to the surface per unit length.

name: Capillary Action
description: Calculates the height to which a liquid is elevated or depressed in a capillary tube.
